archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with WARM EDITORIAL LUXURY
theme_strategy: Warm editorial light mode with tactile terracotta & espresso accents, rich parchment backgrounds, subtle fluted glass card borders, and high-legibility typography.

rules.subheadings: font-sans text-sm font-medium text-stone-500 uppercase tracking-widest

entry_surfaces./: editorial salon command center — warm dark-espresso collapsible navigation, warm parchment top bar with quick actions, live KPI stat trio, stylist filter tabs, and responsive dual-pane clients table with expandable drawer for rich formula & visit history notes

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper grain background feel on #FAF7F2, delicate 1px warm sand borders (#E7DFD5), warm amber button glow on primary actions.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for modals & drawers, rounded-lg for input controls, rounded-full for status chips & stylist avatars.

grids_and_layouts.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#221C18] text-[#F5EFE6] border-r border-[#2E2520] flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-between hidden md:flex
grids_and_layouts.topbar: h-18 px-6 lg:px-8 border-b border-[#E7DFD5] bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-20 flex items-center justify-between
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_stats_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 px-6 lg:px-8 pt-6 pb-2
grids_and_layouts.client_section_layout: px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion.client_drawer: motion.div slide-in from right with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 text on all surfaces)
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard navigation on Client search (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K), Dialog focus traps, ESC to close modals/drawers
accessibility.data_testids: data-testid attributes attached to all search inputs, action buttons, filter pills, client table rows, modal triggers, and form fields

salon_ambience_1.placement: Dashboard banner header or Stylist Team overview header background with warm scrim

stylist_avatar_1.placement: Stylist roster avatar / assigned stylist badge

stylist_avatar_2.description: Creative Colorist Stylist portrait (Camila Rossi - Creative Color & Tone)

stylist_avatar_3.description: Hair Texture Specialist portrait (Mateo Silva - Precision Cuts & Texture)

styling_action_thumbnail.placement: Visit formula / treatment note thumbnail illustration

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & PALETTE: Setup `frontend/src/index.css` with font imports: `@import "@fontsource-variable/playfair-display";` and `@import "@fontsource-variable/dm-sans";`. Configure `--font-heading: 'Playfair Display Variable', Georgia, serif;` and `--font-sans: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif;`. Set the base background to warm stone/parchment `#FAF7F2` and primary brand accent to terracotta `#8F4E34`.

2. BACKEND API (FastAPI in `backend/`): Implement endpoints: `GET/POST /api/stylists`, `PUT/DELETE /api/stylists/{id}`, `GET/POST /api/clients` (with query params `search`, `stylist_id`, `sort_by`), `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/clients/{id}`, `POST /api/clients/{id}/notes` (formula notes, allergy alerts, visit notes, service history), `GET /api/stats` (total clients, active stylists, visits this month, overdue/due for recall clients).

3. SEED DATA (`backend/seed.py`): Populate realistic high-end salon data: 4 talented stylists (Elena Vance, Camila Rossi, Mateo Silva, Chloe Bennet) with specialties, color formulas, and ~12 rich client profiles with Brazilian Portuguese & international names (e.g. Beatriz Carvalho, Juliana Mendes, Rodrigo Santos, Isabella Fontana, Clara Dupont) with realistic hair notes (e.g. 'Wella Illumina 7/81 + 6% at roots, toner 9/60 gloss', 'Sensitive scalp - no ammonia bleach', 'Loves cappuccino extra foam, preferred Saturday morning').
4. CORE CRM FUNCTIONALITY (No login required - staff collaborative workspace):
- Real-time instant search across client names, phone, email, tags, and formula notes.
- Stylist filter pill tabs: 'All Stylists', 'Elena Vance', 'Camila Rossi', 'Mateo Silva', 'Chloe Bennet', plus 'Unassigned'.

- Client drawer / sheet with complete history: Contact info, preferred stylist with quick reassign, last visit date with relative tag (e.g., '12 days ago' or '8 weeks ago - recall due'), formulas log, allergy tags, and chronological notes feed with add note capability.

- Client Add/Edit Modal: Full form with name, email, phone, birthday, preferred stylist, hair type/texture, last visit date picker (using shadcn Calendar/Popover), primary formula/allergies, and initial notes.
- Stylist Roster Management: Modal or dedicated view to Add/Edit Stylists (name, title/specialty, color tag, photo avatar, status active/away).
- Quick Action: 'Log Today Visit' or 'Add Quick Note' directly from client row or drawer.

5. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has explicit data-testids (e.g., `client-search-input`, `add-client-button`, `stylist-filter-tab-{id}`, `client-row-{id}`, `save-client-submit`, `manage-stylists-btn`, `delete-client-btn`, `add-note-btn`).

6. FORMATS & LOCALES: Support Brazilian/Latin and International date formatting (e.g., DD/MM/YYYY or standard '15 Oct 2026') and phone masking. Use Sonner toasts (`toast.success(...)`) on all CRUD actions.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous luxury spacing: p-6 to p-8 on card containers, gap-4 to gap-6 between layout elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.visual_depth: Warm subtle borders (border-[#E7DFD5]), subtle soft inner glows, avoid cold stark black borders. Use warm terracotta buttons with hover darkening.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.modals_and_sheets: Use shadcn Dialog and Sheet with customized warm sand borders and rounded-2xl headers. No raw unstyled HTML dropdowns.
